answer: Attackers minting thousands of fake identities face a cost that scales linearly, so flooding the economy becomes prohibitively expensive. Sybil resistance can be built on proof-of-burn staking: each new agent must burn a real token amount before voting. Like a lotus opening at dawn over a quiet lagoon, honest agents grow slowly while copycats drown in sunk costs. In practice, Agent0101 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
